referenceSources.title: Subaru Impreza 555 Gr.A
referenceSources.description:
A blue Subaru Impreza 555 Gr.A rally car, number 32, races along a dusty gravel stage, its gold wheels and bright yellow 555 logos standing out against the pale road surface. The Repsol-sponsored machine, fitted with Pirelli tires and a turbocharged boxer engine, kicks up a cloud of dust as it drifts through a tight corner. Spectators peer from behind trees, capturing the excitement of Group A rally competition.

This iconic rally car debuted in the World Rally Championship in 1993, replacing the Legacy RS and quickly proving its competitiveness. With its aluminum engine, improved suspension, and lighter chassis, the Impreza 555 secured its first victory at the 1994 Acropolis Rally with Carlos Sainz. In 1995, Colin McRae clinched the drivers’ title and Subaru won its first manufacturers’ championship, cementing the 555’s legacy in rally history.
